Bill.BriefDescription: Prohibiting civil or criminal liabilities or penalties for actions related to the Washington state health insurance pool.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to prohibiting civil or criminal liabilities orpenalties for actions related to the Washington state health insurancepool; and amending RCW 48.41.190.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 48.41.190 and 1989 c 121 s 10 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: ((Neither the participation by members, the establishment of rates,forms, or procedures for coverages issued by the pool, nor any otherjoint or collective action required by this chapter or the state ofWashington shall be the basis of any legal action,)) There shall be nocivil or criminal liability or penalty ((against the pool, any memberof the board of directors, or members of the pool either jointly orseparately)) on the part of, and no cause of action of any nature shallarise against, the pool; against any member, board director, officer,or employee of the pool; or against the commissioner or thecommissioner's representatives or employees, for any action taken ornot taken in good faith, including any discretionary decision or p. 1 SB 6334failure to make a discretionary decision, in the performance of thepowers and duties under this chapter.
